name: Pull-Up
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar overhand slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull chest toward the bar by driving elbows down and back.
Clear bar with chin, pause, and lower under complete control.
coachTips: Depress shoulder blades before pulling (active hang to pull).
breathingTip: Exhale as you pull up; inhale as you lower.
progressionNote: Use resistance band assistance if needed; advance to weighted pull-ups.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit securely with thighs tucked under the pads.
Grip bar wide, lean back slightly (10-15 degrees).
Pull bar down smoothly to upper collarbone.
Return bar with controlled stretch to starting position.
commonMistakes: Leaning back too far turning it into a row
coachTips: Lead the movement with your elbows, pulling them down towards your pockets.
breathingTip: Exhale as bar reaches chest; inhale as it returns.
progressionNote: Increase pin weight in small 2.5kg increments.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward at hips with soft knees until torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Hold barbell with an overhand grip just outside knees.
Pull bar into lower ribcage/navel, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Lower barbell under control without rounding back.
coachTips: Keep core tightly braced and imagine pulling with elbows.
breathingTip: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you row into your abdomen.
progressionNote: Master hip hinge mechanics before heavy loading.

name: Chest-Supported Row (Lower-Back Friendly)
instructions: Lie face down on a 45-degree incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Row dumbbells upward towards your hips while keeping chest firmly against pad.
Squeeze shoulder blades for 1 second at the top, then lower slowly.
commonMistakes: Lifting chest off the pad to cheat
coachTips: Takes 100% of the strain off your lumbar spine while isolating upper back.
breathingTip: Exhale as you pull; inhale as you release.
progressionNote: Focus on peak contraction hold at top.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place knee and hand of one side on bench for support, other foot flat on ground.
Hold dumbbell with free hand hanging straight down.
Pull dumbbell upward towards hip crease, keeping elbow tight to ribcage.
Lower slowly to a full lats stretch.
commonMistakes: Twisting torso excessively to yank the weight
coachTips: Pull back towards your pocket, not straight up to your armpit.
breathingTip: Exhale on pull; inhale on stretch.
progressionNote: Progress independently on each arm to fix imbalances.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit on the machine with feet against footrests, knees slightly bent.
Grab V-bar attachment with arms extended and upright posture.
Pull handle into lower abdomen while keeping shoulders back and down.
Slowly return to start with control.
coachTips: Maintain an upright chest and squeeze your back muscles like pinching a pencil.
progressionNote: Increase hold duration at full contraction.

name: Inverted Row (Bodyweight Australian Pull-Up)
instructions: Position a bar at waist height in a rack or use sturdy table.
Hang underneath with heels on floor and body straight.
Pull chest up to touch the bar.
Lower back down with control.
coachTips: Bend knees to make it easier; elevate feet to make it harder.
breathingTip: Exhale pulling up; inhale lowering down.
progressionNote: Step feet forward towards horizontal to increase difficulty.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Attach rope to cable set at eye level.
Grip with thumbs pointing backwards.
Pull rope towards bridge of nose while externally rotating shoulders.
Hold for 1 second, feel rear delts and upper back engage.
commonMistakes: Using too much weight and leaning backwards
coachTips: One of the best exercises for shoulder longevity and posture.
breathingTip: Exhale on pull; inhale on release.
progressionNote: Prioritize perfect form and pause over weight.
